transcript.text: Hello, welcome back to the On Print Shop Add on Modules tutorial series.
In today's video we will walk through the flow of the artwork approval process through our proofing tool.
In print order processing, a vast amount of time is spent on the artwork approval process, which includes plenty of emails with an enormous amount of time and energy.

To address this concern, we have designed a proofing tool especially for print service providers and for those who serve graphic designing to users and want to save time on proofing and artwork approval.
Through the design proofing tool, your customers can preview and provide immediate feedback on the designs, which designers can understand and quickly make necessary changes for final approval.
This process can be continued without any hassle till the time your customer doesn't find the design.
Well, this proofing tool comes into concern when your customer chooses to upload their design via the upload center.
So let's check out the artwork proofing cycle in the admin panel.
Go to the Order listing page and let's take the example where you have a product order for a business card and the customer has uploaded the design.
Now the admin finds that the artwork must be modified as per the printing guidelines and decides to modify the design.
For this, the admin will find a modified design button under the Order Update section on the order product details.
Just like the regular modified design flow, admin will find the option to Upload Design or select User Design.
In the Upload Design tab.
The admin can upload the modified design and put some comments regarding the updates made to the design to ask for the customer's approval.
Before finalizing the design, the admin must enable the Ask for Approval setting.
When enabled, the system will automatically change the order status to Awaiting Approval and the toggle of visual proof will appear.
The Visual Proof setting will enable the Visual Proof tool and customers will get an option to view the design changes made in the Proofing tool.
In the Select User Design tab, the admin will get an option to select User Design, that is, the designs created by the customer who has placed the order.
However, they'll have the option to select from the designs created by other customers.
Similar to uploading a design, you can enable visual proofing for your customers.
Once you have modified the design and performed the relevant settings, save the changes.
Now let's check how this will work for the end customer.
On the front end under the My Orders section, the customer will find the order product status as Awaiting proof approval along with a button of Review your Proof.
When the customer clicks on the button, it will be redirected to the visual proof screen.
The proofing tool includes all sorts of panels which will help the customers to add comments to the design and suggest changes.
The first one is the top panel which contains a highlight pointer, circle and pencil tool.
Along with these, there is a reset, zoom in, zoom out, a color box, and more.
Customers can select any tool, point it to the design and write a comment.
These comments will appear in the comments section.
You can use the bin icon to delete any comment.
A navigation panel is also provided which will help the customers switch between different product pages.
This will be very helpful for products like calendars and photo books.
Once they have reviewed and added their comments, they can save, download and print the design.
When the customer clicks on the continue button it will show three options to customers Approve as is, approved with changes and make changes and send new proof.

When the customer is happy with the design shared and looks for no further changes, the customer will click on Approve as is and the Order Product status changes to Proof Approved indicating that the admin can proceed with printing the design.
When clicking on the Approved with Changes option, the proof will be approved automatically once the changes suggested by the customers are made.
Here, the admin can continue without asking for approval from the customer.
However, the admin will have the option open where they can ask for the customers approval with the Make changes and send New Proof option.
The customer instructs the admin to share the new design with the changes made.
This is how the proofing tool reduces the time and errors during the design approval process, thus allowing your team of designers to focus more on creative ideas rather than the process.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
